_comment: seasonalItemIds: item ids of consumables/tokens from seasonal events that have ended. Empty on purpose until verified in-game; the rule is low-confidence and unchecked by default anyway. retiredCurrencyNames: English item names of currencies that can no longer be earned. Tomestones are derived from the game's TomestonesItem sheet and do not need listing here. protectedItemIds: things that can never be regained once lost; Tidy Up never lists them. Ultimate weapons are recognised from game data instead.
